title: Bacon Cheeseburger Soup
ingredients: Chopped celery and carrots (equal in amount to the onion)
1/4 cup sour cream (or 1/2 block cream cheese)
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large stock pot. Once cooked, use a paper towel to remove excess grease, then remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the bacon grease and 1 Tbsp butter to the pot over medium heat. Once melted, add the onion, carrots and celery, season with basil, salt and pepper, and stir until tender.
Once the carrots are softened, add the remaining 3 Tbsp butter and the flour, stirring to coat evenly. Cook a few minutes to brown and remove the raw flour taste.
Add the potatoes and stir until incorporated. Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a light boil, stirring occasionally.
Once the potatoes are fork tender, add the milk, sour cream and Velveeta. Stir until the cheese is completely melted into the soup.
Turn off the heat and add the chopped bacon, saving some to garnish if desired. Taste and adjust seasoning. Top with parsley or serve with crackers and croutons.
notes: Recipe from Justin Holmes (Holmes Cooking) reel; full recipe was in the author's pinned first comment. Add the browned ground beef back to the soup with the potatoes (the comment sets it aside but does not say when to return it). Commenter tip: save bacon grease in a mason jar in the pantry.
